# The Well Guide

> Independent resource for private well owners on pumps, pressure tanks, water testing, treatment, and contaminant remediation.

The Well Guide is an independent publication for the 15 percent of U.S. homeowners on private wells. Content covers well drilling, pump replacement, pressure tanks, water testing, treatment systems (softeners, iron filters, whole-house filtration), contaminant guides (arsenic, iron, sulfur, bacteria), and problem diagnosis. Cost guides and calculators return real 2026 estimates for drilling, pump replacement, treatment, and testing. Free quotes for well work are available through partner Networx.

- [Well Water Smells Like Sulfur or Rotten Eggs: Causes and Fixes](https://www.thewell.guide/problems/well-water-smells-like-sulfur): If your well water smells like sulfur or rotten eggs, hydrogen sulfide is the cause. Four sources, hot vs. cold water diagnosis, and every treatment option.
- [Well Water Tastes Bad: What Each Taste Tells You and How to Fix It](https://www.thewell.guide/problems/well-water-tastes-bad): Every bad well water taste mapped to its specific cause, health risk, required test, and treatment. Know what your water is telling you.
